يسترضون (form X)
# يَسْتَرْضُونَ (yastarḍūna) /jas.tar.dˤuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَرْضَى (istarḍā)
# يُسْتَرْضَوْنَ (yustarḍawna) /jus.tar.dˤaw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَرْضَى (istarḍā)
